name: weather-widget-platform
purpose: Graduate the donor widget operating model, polished widget UI, gestures, layout system, catalog UX, theme behavior, split-workbench patterns, plugin directory patterns, and demo-backed widgets into reusable AgentSam package authority.
migration_rules: Preserve polished visible UI and interaction behavior wherever practical.
Do not require all widgets to have live production adapters before being visible.
Demo-backed widgets may ship with explicit Demo status until real adapters exist.
Settings -> Customize -> Widgets is the canonical widget library/configuration surface.
Widgets may render on any eligible host surface, including AgentSam side-stage panels.
The standalone /widgets product route is not the long-term product model.
Hosted Local Studio and packaged desktop must consume the same widget package code.
Theme behavior must inherit canonical AgentSam semantic tokens rather than create an isolated theme authority.
staging_rule: Donor source is preserved outside src so it is not compiled or exported until deliberately graduated.
